description: This file defines a PHP class 'PayGrade' which is an entity representing pay grade data in the OrangeHRM system. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping to a database table, including properties for id, name, and related pay grade currencies, along with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: PayGrade
classes.description: Represents a pay grade entity with properties for id, name, and related pay grade currencies, using Doctrine ORM annotations for persistence mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the pay grade.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the pay grade.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the pay grade.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencies
methods.description: Gets the collection of associated PayGradeCurrency entities.

methods.name: setPayGradeCurrencies
methods.description: Replaces the collection of associated PayGradeCurrency entities.
